data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name 'Akathina', meaning pure, sincere, or 'uncontested'. In Christian tradition, Katrine is a feminine form of Catherine, meaning pure and chaste. The name Katrine carries the meaning “Pure, Sincere” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Katrine usually hope their child will grow to embody pure, sincere and live with faith, good character and purpose.
